_howto: STATUS: "hidden" = no Merch tab, page noindex, not in sitemap. "teaser" = Merch tab and a Launching soon page (indexable, in sitemap). "live" = the shop page. To launch: for each product fill in price, url and images (files in src/assets/merch/), set show:true for the ones that are ready, then set status to "live". Products with show:false are not displayed.
